component.name: Opaline
component.summary: Glass widgets for your Ubuntu desktop

description.p: Opaline brings customizable glass widgets to the Ubuntu 26.04 / GNOME 50 desktop. Place, move, resize, and stack live widgets right on your wallpaper — above desktop icons and below application windows, across multiple monitors.

Includes fourteen built-in widgets (Clock, CPU, Memory, GPU, Storage, Network, Battery & Power, Fans, Processes, Now Playing, Audio Visualizer, Weather, Calendar, and Docker), dynamic Material 3 Expressive themes, Peek and Edit modes, and zero telemetry.

Opaline 2.0.2: the Clock keeps following the system time; timers, the stopwatch and Pomodoro keep counting through sleep and restarts; weather and custom data sources refresh right after waking up; plugins are no longer restarted after the desktop was covered; numbers use your language's format everywhere; large numbers fit their card; the memory tile no longer shows a stray slash.

Opaline 2.0.1: theme number styles now reach every widget in all ten looks, with larger numbers in Opaline and Crystal; cards no longer cut off their first line; clearer messages for GPUs without usage data and disks without health data.

Opaline 2.0.0: 30 built-in widgets, Glass 2.0 and 10 themes, a live Inspector, Free mode and a visual Widget Builder, custom data sources with GNOME Keyring secrets, desktop profiles and automation rules, the opaline ctl command and D-Bus API v2, sandboxed plugins with a signed community gallery, and full English, German and Arabic support.

Opaline 1.1.0: full desktop click-through outside Edit/Peek mode, speaker-monitor PipeWire capture without triggering the GNOME microphone indicator, transparent frameless surface mode, in-app per-widget customizer and transparency controls, 10 audio visualizer styles with color palettes and glow, and expanded CPU, RAM (slots, speed, DDR type, manufacturer), GPU, and storage hardware info fields.

Opaline 1.0.0: fourteen customizable glass widgets, Native GNOME 50 Wayland and Instant Xwayland desktop integration, Android-style Edit mode with stacks and presets, Settings and Onboarding, verified updates, and English, German, and Arabic (RTL) support.
